articles.author: Ellen Phiddian
articles.title: How seriously should we take biological threats from AI?
articles.description: AI companies say their tools could be used to make biological weaponry. These are the threats and what can be done to mitigate them.
articles.content:
The AI industry is suddenly rife with existential fears, with senior figures claiming it could "kill us all" within a decade.
